$2 Million Line of Credit from Meta Alliance Provides Capital to Complete SEC Registration, Advance a 100+ Unit Residential Development Near Clemson University and Expand Oxygen Mortgage

ANDERSON, S.C., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ideal Group of Companies, Inc. (OTC: IDGR) ("IDGR” or the "Company”), a diversified real estate development and financing company, today outlined its plan to become a fully reporting company with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC”) as the first step toward an uplisting to NASDAQ or AMEX. In parallel, the Company is advancing a series of real estate transactions in its South Carolina development pipeline toward closing.

To fund these initiatives, IDGR has secured a $2 million line of credit from Meta Alliance, a Florida-based global private capital firm. The Company expects to use the proceeds to cover the costs of SEC registration and ongoing reporting, to advance its South Carolina real estate projects and to expand Oxygen Mortgage, its mortgage banking subsidiary.

"Becoming a fully reporting company and pursuing an uplisting are central to how we intend to build long-term value for our shareholders,” said Charles Cardona of Ideal Group of Companies. "The Meta Alliance facility gives us the capital to complete that process while we move our South Carolina projects toward closing. We are building in one of the strongest housing markets in the country, and we believe that greater transparency and broader access to institutional capital will allow us to grow the business on a stronger foundation.”

Path to SEC Reporting Status and Uplisting

The Company intends to register with the SEC and become a fully reporting issuer. Reporting status is a prerequisite for listing on a national securities exchange. Management believes that completing this process will broaden IDGR’s access to institutional investors, improve trading liquidity and increase the Company’s visibility within the investment community.

South Carolina Real Estate Pipeline

IDGR is concentrating its development activity in South Carolina, which the U.S. Census Bureau’s Vintage 2025 population estimates ranked as the fastest-growing state in the nation by percentage between July 2024 and July 2025. The state’s favorable tax environment, relatively low cost of living, moderate climate, strong job growth and business-friendly regulatory framework continue to attract new residents and employers, sustaining demand for residential housing.

The Company’s pipeline includes a residential development of more than 100 units near Clemson University. IDGR intends to apply a portion of the facility toward advancing this project and additional transactions in the region toward closing.

Expansion of Oxygen Mortgage

A portion of the proceeds will support the expansion of Oxygen Mortgage, the Company’s mortgage banking subsidiary, which complements IDGR’s development activities by providing financing capabilities within its core markets.

The Company anticipates that additional funding may become available to support the further expansion of its project portfolio.
